entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jabi, also known by his title Jabi Maripgan, was the 20th ruler of the Koreanic kingdom Silla. He was the eldest son of King Nulji, and his mother was the daughter of King Silseong. He married the daughter of Kim Misaheun.
